name: Coca-Cola Atlanta Syrup Plant - Atlanta GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entrance off Browns Mill Rd SE; checkpoint canopy/structure visible in Street View (2025-03) near flagpoles, with barrier across the truck lane visible in z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small staffed booth/checkpoint canopy beside the truck lane at the entrance drive, distinct from the main building.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron with room for additional lanes; long internal approach drive.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive diagonal trailer-parking stalls south and east of the main building hold 100+ trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail line runs along the eastern property boundary with a spur curving into the south yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on both the north building face (red Coca-Cola trucks) and the southwest face suggest separate dock clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale identified in imagery; left false but flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~35 across north and southwest dock faces from z18/z19 imagery; approximate.
